irfan_arch: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a per-tenant "handoff" proxy in customer VPCs. central CP issues desired state; proxy reconciles routes/ENI and handles certing/audit streaming. pros/cons?

tara_infra: fewer peering links is attractive. question: how do we keep AWS API calls under quota when many tenants spin proxies?

jules_net: two approaches: aggregated CIDRs behind a single ENI per AZ, or program only a single handoff route and let regional relay handle per-tenant mapping. aggregation reduces RT churn.

meera_sre: operational risk: ephemeral proxies increase object churn and cause teardown races we've seen. need idempotent create/destroy + reconcile loops with exponential backoff. add clear metrics for boot latency and reconcile failures.

sam_prod: customer asks: where do audit logs land? ensure proxies stream to customer-owned encrypted sinks and we persist signed digests in CP for tracing. logs must survive proxy termination.

sec-bot: security note: require cross-account role with least privilege (ReplaceRoute/Describe/ENI create limited by tags), short-lived certs, and an allowlist of subnets/RTs. mandate CFN authorization flow for onboarding.

irfan_arch: action items: 1) prototype ENI+aggregated-route spike, 2) run a 200-tenant API rate test, 3) draft CFN + minimal IAM policy, 4) SRE playbook for teardown races. will share spike PR and schedule follow-up next week.
